subject: Bootcamp sponsorship — credit structure and invoicing
messages:
From: Sam Yang <sam.yang@foundersbootcamp.org>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsorship + credits — MOA and how credits show up on invoices

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. Founders Bootcamp is keen to confirm the structure for the sponsorship we're discussing (two cohort months, ~120 participants total). A few questions from our finance and partnerships teams:

- Can Redwood issue a single sponsor invoice with a line-item for "sponsorship fee" and then a separate line for the applied credits, or do credits need to be tracked as prepaid vouchers?
- Are free/onboarding credits refundable or non-refundable? Our sponsors want clarity for their accounting team.
- Do credits apply across Hosted API and Dedicated capacity equally or do we need separate allocations for private clusters?
- We attached a draft MOA and a proposed credit schedule (attached). Can you confirm what your standard billing cadence would be for a $10k sponsorship plus $5k in onboarding credits?

Attached: FoundersBootcamp_MOA_draft.pdf, credit-schedule.xlsx

Appreciate a short note on options so we can loop in our CFO.

Best,
Sam
Sam Yang
Partnerships Manager, Founders Bootcamp
partners@foundersbootcamp.org
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Yang <sam.yang@foundersbootcamp.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship + credits — MOA and how credits show up on invoices

Hi Sam — great to connect earlier. Short answers up front and two recommended paths depending on your sponsor's accounting preferences.

1) Invoice method: we can do a single master invoice for the sponsorship fee (net 30) with a separate line item called "Promotional credit applied" showing the credit value as a negative line. That keeps everything on one invoice for your finance team.

2) Voucher method: if sponsors prefer a pre-funded pool, we can issue prepaid credits (voucher codes) that get drawn down per cohort. These vouchers are useful if you want to allocate credits to different partner orgs.

Refund policy: promotional/onboarding credits are typically non-refundable unless there is a contract-level cancellation or material breach. We can add a clause for partial refunds by exception, but standard practice is non-refundable.

Hosted vs Dedicated: credits apply to hosted API by default. For Dedicated (private clusters) we treat credits as eligible only for usage-based line items (tokens) and not for dedicated reserved capacity fees without a prior written agreement. If your sponsor needs credits to cover dedicated nodes, we can structure a carve-out in the MOA.

Proposed quick option (to get you running):
- Master invoice for sponsor fee ($10,000) net 30.
- Apply $3,000 onboarding credit as a negative line on invoice.
- Issue $2,000 in voucher codes for cohort-specific redemption (two vouchers of $1,000 each).

I'll loop in our billing lead Lauren for the exact line-item wording and for a DocuSign MOA flow. If that sounds reasonable, we can share a revised MOA and a one-page schedule showing how credits flow.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Yang <sam.yang@foundersbootcamp.org>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship + credits — MOA and how credits show up on invoices

Following Rishi's note — quick commercial addendum from Sales:

- For partner-sponsored cohorts we can approve a one-time promotional exception to increase onboarding credits to $5k (instead of $3k) if the sponsor commits to a $25k minimum consumption over 6 months. This is a promo exception, so will need a brief approval in HubSpot.
- If Founders Bootcamp wants a clean accounting treatment for sponsors, we recommend the master invoice + credit line approach (easier for reconciliation).

Ben, can the partnerships team confirm whether AviLab (Ava Labs) will co-sponsor and whether we should route any credits separately?

Sam — happy to jump on a 15-min call later today if you'd like to walk through options.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner & Channel Sales
marissa@redwood.com
From: Sam Yang <sam.yang@foundersbootcamp.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship + credits — MOA and how credits show up on invoices

Thanks Marissa and Rishi — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from our finance lead:

- Can you confirm credit visibility on the invoice (we need the negative line to show a clear applied amount for audit)?
- Are credits tax-exclusive (i.e., apply before sales tax) or do we show tax on the gross sponsorship fee and then tax on the net? Our tax advisor prefers seeing tax on the net paid amount.
- If Ava Labs co-sponsors, can credits be split across sponsors and reflected on a single invoice (each sponsor gets a line)?

We can do a short call tomorrow AM. Also, on SOC2: our security team asked whether Redwood can provide a SOC2 report or a security questionnaire — happy to include that in the MOA packet.

Thanks,
Sam
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Sam Yang <sam.yang@foundersbootcamp.org>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship + credits — MOA and how credits show up on invoices

Hi Sam — looping in Lauren from Billing (that's me) with the invoicing specifics you requested.

- Invoice visibility: yes — we will include a discrete negative line item titled "Applied promotional credit (Founders Bootcamp)" showing the exact dollar amount applied. That line is visible on the invoice PDF and in the AR export.
- Tax treatment: we calculate tax on the net payable amount after credits are applied by default, but we can change that if your legal team requires an alternate treatment. We'll surface both views in the invoice appendix so your tax advisor can confirm.
- Multiple sponsors: we can bill a single invoice and allocate sponsorship rows per sponsor (e.g., "Ava Labs — sponsorship $5,000; Applied credit — $1,500"). Each sponsor will receive an emailed copy with their allocated line items if you'd like separate receipts.

DocuSign & next steps:
- I'll prepare a revised MOA with the billing appendix and a snapshot of the credit-schedule. I'll send a DocuSign link for signatures once you confirm the sponsor allocation and whether you'd like the promo exception (increased onboarding credit to $5k) approved.
- SOC2: attaching standard pointer to our compliance packet. If you need the full report we can coordinate an NDA/redaction flow.

Attachments: FoundersBootcamp_MOA_revised.pdf (to follow via DocuSign), billing-appendix-sample.pdf

Thanks — happy to answer any follow-ups.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
